correctness.rationale: Exact-zero and positive-support constraints are applied with correct quantifiers. The disjoint mandatory-one regions yield inequality (1); optimizing it over s=max(r,c), t=min(r,c) rules out k<m for m>=4. Width-three and width-two exceptions are checked separately with the extra support constraints; k>=m forces exactly m twos and gives only a full column or, on squares, a row. The k=0 all-one case is included. Executed standalone brute and bounded exact subset enumeration reproduce all optimal counts on thirteen test boards; finite tests are checks, while the general argument proves the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: Determines not merely the minimum weight but *every optimizer* for the natural infinite two-parameter family of rook/Hamming graphs for a recently introduced domination condition. The proof uncovers rigidity to a single complete fiber, the square-board symmetry transition and exceptional nine additional C4 labelings. The optimizer multiplicities n, 2m and 13 do not follow from the numerical result alone, and the forced-row/column cross argument is a reusable structural method. Graph-product extremizers are a motivated exact-enumeration question.
